verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents its own FireHydrant-hosted external status pages, and its pricing lists unlimited public status pages, so the core hosted public page exists. Incident-driven updates are documented only for the internal per-incident status pages, not the public ones. The pack has nothing on custom domains or subscriber notifications for public pages. missing for 10: custom domain support, subscriber notifications, documentation that public pages are driven from incident state, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can publish a hosted public status page — custom domain, subscriber notifications — driven from incident state

citations.quote: as well as external status pages (Atlassian and FireHydrant-hosted).
All incident notes/updates posted via Slack (`/fh update`) or via Command Center are posted to the Internal Status Page
